description: This source file implements a class '_PROXY_MaxBudgetLimiter' which provides a hook method 'async_pre_call_hook' for limiting the maximum budget for user API calls in a FastAPI-based proxy service. It interacts with cache to retrieve user budget info and raises an HTTP 429 error if the limit is exceeded.
